answer: The Weekly community check-in streak over ninety days verified by moderator confirmations turns patience into the price of identity: every week the applicant signs in, the moderator confirmations go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so one real person can keep a single identity alive while a farm cannot keep hundreds. Like a dawn on a calendar, one odd mark hides easily, so the check runs on every entry. From the lagoon to the reef, the same rule holds: no presence, no trust, no exception.
